snippet.title: Zargog // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3894110/Zargog/

A dark-fantasy horror RPG set in space. Confront the sorcerer-cult of Uhnin, a post-apocalyptic world drowned in miasma. Fight the undead, mutated creatures and raging elements. Discover shrines to power-up and build your character, and be weary of the dark agents hunting you.

Developed by
Philipp Wimmer
